name: Bullock Texas State History Museum
hours_summary: Mon–Sat · 10 AM – 5 PM · Sun noon – 5 PM
tagline: Three floors telling the Texas story, plus the recovered La Belle shipwreck.
description: The state history museum two blocks north of the Capitol, with three permanent floors stepping through Native Texas, Spanish colonial rule, independence, oil, and the modern state. The ground floor holds the hull of La Belle — La Salle's 1686 French expedition ship, raised from Matagorda Bay and reassembled here.

tips.text: La Belle is the signature piece — budget a half hour at the ship alone.
The IMAX and Texas Spirit Theater add on — the combo ticket is better value if you plan to see a film.
